results.name: Dumbbells Plank to Alternating Row
instructions: Begin in a high plank position with your hands gripping a dumbbell each on the floor, directly under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Your feet should be slightly wider than hip-width apart for stability.
Keeping your core tight, lift the right dumbbell off the floor, rowing it towards your right hip while balancing on your left hand and feet.
Lower the dumbbell back to the floor with control, returning to the high plank position.
Repeat the rowing motion with your left hand, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your body as you row.
Maintain a straight line from head to heels throughout the exercise.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form without compromising balance.
results.description: Dumbbells Plank to Alternating Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Biceps, Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbells Single Arm Row
instructions: Place your left knee and left hand on a bench, lean your torso down to almost parallel to the floor. Your right foot should be planted firmly on the floor, knee bent and slightly behind for balance. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand, arm extended towards the floor.
Pull the dumbbell towards your hip by bending your elbow, keeping it close to your body. Focus on squeezing your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arm with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to perform the exercise with your left arm.
tips: Avoid rotating your torso as you row; keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
Use a controlled motion to lift and lower the dumbbell.
Ensure your supporting knee and hand are positioned securely on the bench for stability.
results.description: Dumbbells Single Arm Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms, Core.

results.name: Good Mornings Barbell
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip.
Begin to hinge at your hips, pushing your hips back while lowering your torso towards the floor.
Continue to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the floor.
Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and raising your torso back up. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a straight back and avoid rounding your spine.
Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist.
Keep a slight bend in your knees to reduce stress on your lower back.
results.description: Good Mornings Barbell is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Good Mornings Dumbbells
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Bring the dumbbells at shoulder height, with your elbows bent and pointing forward.
Begin to hinge at your hips, pushing your hips back while lowering your torso towards the floor.
Continue to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the floor, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and raising your torso back up. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a straight back and avoid rounding your spine.
Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist.
Keep a slight bend in your knees to reduce stress on your lower back.
results.description: Good Mornings Dumbbells is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Good Mornings Kettlebell
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands at chest height. Keep your elbows bent and pointing downward.
Begin to hinge at your hips, pushing your hips back while lowering your torso towards the floor.
Continue to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the floor, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and raising your torso back up. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a straight back and avoid rounding your spine.
Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist.
Keep a slight bend in your knees to reduce stress on your lower back.
results.description: Good Mornings Kettlebell is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Good Mornings Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, placing a resistance band under both feet. Hold a handle with each hand and place it close to your shoulders.
Hinge at your hips to lower your torso forward until it is almost parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Slowly return to the starting position by extending your hips and knees to raise your torso.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your spine.
Focus on engaging your glutes and hamstrings throughout the movement.
Exhale as you raise your torso and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Good Mornings Resistance Band is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Alternate Arms
instructions: Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row machine with your feet flat on the floor and your chest pressed against the chest pad. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing forward.
Pull one handle towards your torso by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blade back, while keeping the other arm extended.
Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the pad and your back straight throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your back muscles throughout the movement.
Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
results.description: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Alternate Arms is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Both Arms
instructions: Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row machine with your feet flat on the floor and your chest pressed against the chest pad. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing forward.
Pull both handles towards your torso by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades back.
Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement and slowly return the handles to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the pad and your back straight throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your back muscles throughout the movement.
Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
results.description: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Both Arms is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Single Arm
instructions: Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row machine with your feet flat on the floor and your chest pressed against the chest pad. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing forward.
Pull the right handle towards your torso by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blade back, while keeping the other arm extended.
Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the same arm for the desired number of repetitions and then switch to your left arm and repeat.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the pad and your back straight throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your back muscles throughout the movement.
Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
results.description: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Single Arm is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Inverted Rows on Smith Machine
instructions: Position a bar on the smith machine at about waist height. Lie on your back underneath the bar with your legs extended and your heels on the floor.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your chest towards the bar by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower yourself back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your back muscles to pull yourself up, rather than your arms.
Adjust the height of the bar or your foot position to make the exercise easier or harder as needed.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull up and inhaling as you lower yourself down.
Ensure the bar is securely locked in place on the smith machine to prevent any movement.
results.description: Inverted Rows on Smith Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms.
